lines.zh: 我一步踩下去，地都闷响。
lines.en: Each step of mine makes the ground boom.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞开树枝，我不绕路。
lines.en: My shoulder snaps branches; I do not detour.

lines.zh: 铁脚掌落得很慢，但很重。
lines.en: Iron feet land slowly, but heavily.

lines.zh: 我走过，地上是一串浅坑。
lines.en: Where I pass, a string of shallow pits remains.

lines.zh: 我转身要转两下才转过来。
lines.en: Turning takes me two full swings.
The hinge at my waist creaks once.

lines.zh: 我看着脚下的路，不看远处。
lines.en: I watch the ground, not the horizon.
This metal body weighs two hundred catties.
One step of mine sends the chickens flying.
My stride opens wide, like plowing a field.
I crushed a fallen log underfoot.

lines.zh: 重量让我下坡时收不住。
lines.en: My weight makes downhill walking hard to stop.
I walk with my arms held close.
I am slow, yet I never halt.
Standing, I am a wall of iron.
Wind hums through the seam in my chest.
I rotate my wrists slowly.

lines.zh: 甲上有块凹痕，是很早的。
lines.en: A dent in my plate dates from long ago.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的手。
lines.en: I look down at my own hands.

lines.zh: 背后那块铁，是最后装的。
lines.en: The plate on my back went on last.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，只有齿轮声。
lines.en: I do not breathe; only gears turn.

lines.zh: 鸟落在我的肩上，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder; I stay still.
I press my feet a little into the soil.
The sun makes my plating shine.

lines.zh: 我在等身上的伤安静下来。
lines.en: I wait for my hurts to settle.

lines.zh: 头转得慢，但我看得很远。
lines.en: My head turns slowly, but I see far.

lines.zh: 这片院子我守了很多天。
lines.en: I have guarded this yard many days.
A little dust has settled in my joints.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子响一声。
lines.en: I lower my gaze; a neck joint pops.
You stand shorter than my palm is wide.

lines.zh: 你衣上有铁腥味，走近些。
lines.en: Your clothes smell of iron; come closer.
I tip my head slightly to view you.
You raise a hand; I raise mine.

lines.zh: 我在想，你是不是我的主人。
lines.en: I wonder whether you are my maker.
Where did you put your hammer?
You tapped my leg; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: My eyes do not blink while I regard you.
Step back; I will not follow.
The light off my armor falls on your face.

lines.zh: 来过的每一张脸，我都存着。
lines.en: Every face that came here is stored in me.
A plate was beaten inward.
My shoulder axle jammed halfway.
That hammer made me sway.
A thread of hot air seeps from a seam.
I take half a step back and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 胸口的铁裂了一道细纹。
lines.en: A hairline crack opened in my chest.
Pain hardly matters; I remember instead.
I brace my hurt shoulder with a hand.
That blow nearly brought me down.
Being sturdy is my duty.
You hold out iron; I reach for it.
Food? My belly is solid metal.
This copper I could use.
To buy me, bring materials.

lines.zh: 我摇头，整块肩甲都在动。
lines.en: I shake my head and my whole pauldron moves.
Until my maker comes, I do not move.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在我脚边吧。
lines.en: Leave it by my feet, if you like.
I am not greedy for food, only for sturdiness.
This iron is a bit rusty; not good enough.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，又抬起来。
lines.en: I lower my head to sniff, then lift it.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞在一棵树上。
lines.en: Running into me is like hitting a tree.
I lift a foot; you had better move.
Squeeze past beside my leg if you must.
I turn aside, and the ground groans.
One nudge from you rocked me.

lines.zh: 别贴着我脚站，我瞧不见。
lines.en: Do not hug my feet; I cannot see down there.
My knee is higher than your head.
You got squeezed back half a step.

lines.zh: 我放慢动作，免得踩到你。
lines.en: I slow my movements so I do not step on you.
Stand clear; I am shifting forward.

lines.zh: 造我的人只有图纸，没有同类。
lines.en: Only a blueprint made me; I have no kind.

lines.zh: 另一台大的？我们并肩站。
lines.en: Another big one? We stand shoulder to shoulder.

lines.zh: 主人造两个，是为轮流守。
lines.en: My maker built two so we could take turns.

lines.zh: 我们不交谈，只交换位置。
lines.en: We do not talk; we trade places.
It guards the front gate, I the back yard.
We were poured from the same furnace.

lines.zh: 我们碰一下甲，算是招呼。
lines.en: We knock plates once as a greeting.
At night we stand facing outward.
It stands a head shorter; my younger brother.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有话，只有重量。
lines.en: Between us there are no words, only weight.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把整块铁捡起来。
lines.en: I bend and lift the whole iron block.

lines.zh: 这块材料正好补我的肩。
lines.en: This material fits my shoulder exactly.

lines.zh: 我用手掌把矿石拢起来。
lines.en: I scoop the ore up with one palm.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的锤子，我拾起。
lines.en: A dropped hammer; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 东西在我手里显得很小。
lines.en: In my hand, the thing looks tiny.
I set it down beside my maker's feet.
I recognize this armor plate.

lines.zh: 捡的时候，我尽量不捏碎。
lines.en: I try not to crush it while picking it up.
I have two pieces of iron in my pocket.

lines.zh: 这块材料我留着修自己。
lines.en: I keep this material to repair myself.

lines.zh: 那台机器在动，我盯住了。
lines.en: That machine is moving; I have it.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃门，我转过去。
lines.en: Something is gnawing the door; I turn.
It is smaller than me, but it carries fire.

lines.zh: 主人喊了一声，我抬起手臂。
lines.en: My maker shouts, and I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 这片都归我守，谁进都算。
lines.en: This ground is mine; any intruder counts.
I see a light inside the trees.

lines.zh: 它站在院墙外，想翻进来。
lines.en: It stands outside the wall, meaning to climb.

lines.zh: 山脚下有动静，我锁定了。
lines.en: Movement at the hill's foot; I lock on.
I take one step and block the path.
The one with the axe is not short.
It circles me; I follow slowly.
That sound does not belong to this village.
I clench my fists; the joints crack.

lines.zh: 目标确定了，我开始挪步。
lines.en: Target confirmed; I begin to move.

lines.zh: 我不去追，让它自己走近。
lines.en: No chasing; I let it walk to me.

lines.zh: 它跑得比我快，但跑不远。
lines.en: It runs faster than me, but not far.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，地都响。
lines.en: I press forward step by step; the ground booms.

lines.zh: 它躲到柱子后，我推开柱子。
lines.en: It hides behind a pillar; I push it aside.
I raise my fist, and my shadow covers it.

lines.zh: 它的箭打在我胸口，弹开。
lines.en: Its arrow hit my chest and glanced off.
I watch its feet, not its hands.
It backs into the corner, still shouting.
I pause and let it catch its breath.

lines.zh: 我把两只手都抬起来了。
lines.en: I have raised both my hands.

lines.zh: 它换方向，我慢慢转过去。
lines.en: It changes direction; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 院门在我这边，它出不去。
lines.en: The gate is on my side; it cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是齿轮声，越来越快。
lines.en: My breathing is gears, turning faster and faster.
My last step is a wide one.
One punch, and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我把它抓起来，再摔下去。
lines.en: I lift it up and throw it down.
My arm sweeps and a wall corner falls.
It blocked; my fist did not stop.

lines.zh: 重量压上去，它就动不了。
lines.en: With my weight on it, it cannot move.

lines.zh: 铁拳落在甲上，凹了个坑。
lines.en: My iron fist left a crater in its armor.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的腿往旁边甩。
lines.en: I seize its leg and fling it aside.
This blow used both my hands.
It struck me, and my head did not turn.

lines.zh: 拳头上的铁屑掉了一地。
lines.en: Iron flakes fall from my knuckles.
I pin it underfoot and raise my fist.
Its bones crack inside my grip.

lines.zh: 打完，我在裤上擦了擦拳头。
lines.en: Afterwards I wipe my fist on my leg.
That hit will keep it down a long while.

lines.zh: 主人把躯干放下，开始拼装。
lines.en: My maker sets the torso down and begins.

lines.zh: 先装腿，再装肩，最后是头。
lines.en: Legs first, then shoulders, then the head.

lines.zh: 铁水浇进接缝，我有了形状。
lines.en: Molten iron fills the seams; I take shape.

lines.zh: 我站起来，把屋顶顶了一下。
lines.en: I stand and knock the ceiling once.

lines.zh: 第一眼看的是主人的锤子。
lines.en: The first thing I see is my maker's hammer.
My chest is still warm.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，铁响了一声。
lines.en: I try a fist, and the iron rings.
This yard is too small; I must duck.
My maker walks a full circle around me.

lines.zh: 我把脚放在院子的中央。
lines.en: I set my feet in the middle of the yard.
My weight settles and dust rises.
From today, the gate is mine.
I have no name, only measurements.

lines.zh: 主人拍了拍腿，我就懂了。
lines.en: My maker pats a leg, and I understand.

lines.zh: 火烤得我半边身子发红。
lines.en: Flames turn half my body red.
I rolled down the slope and made a crater.

lines.zh: 水没过我的胸口，还在冒泡。
lines.en: Water covers my chest and keeps bubbling.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵里全是回声。
lines.en: After the blast my ears are all echo.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在肩甲上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sits in my pauldron like a splinter.

lines.zh: 紫色的力钻进我的接缝。
lines.en: Violet force seeps into my seams.
Without material, my seams begin to loosen.

lines.zh: 雷从头顶灌进整副铁架。
lines.en: Lightning pours through my whole iron frame.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，铁在黑暗里响。
lines.en: I fall, and iron rings in the darkness.
